lead: A new `CoreTy` variant does not fail `cargo build`; it fails `cargo test -p nvs-stdlib` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ast.rs`.
body: `CoreTy` is `#[non_exhaustive]`, so the out-of-crate matches in `nvs-cli/src/meta.rs` and `nvs-types/src/core_lib.rs` carry wildcards, while `ast.rs`'s `mentions` is exhaustive on purpose and lives under `#[cfg(test)]`. Add the `mentions` arm in the same edit as the variant, and do not trust a green `cargo check`.
